entities.summary: Gideon Isaiah Gartner was an American businessman, investor, and philanthropist. He was often referred to as the father of the modern analyst industry. He is best known as the founder of Gartner, Inc. a Stamford, Connecticut, information technology (IT) research and advisory company.
